'''Aleria Elffin''' was an author of humorous tales.
== Activities ==
While waiting for [[Juilin Sandar]] to bring information on the [[Black Ajah]] in [[Tear]], [[Egwene]] tries to read to distract herself, but even Aleria Elffin's humorous tales cannot hold her interest for more than a few pages.{{ref/book|3|49}}
